## Purpose and approved scope
Describe target decision/workflow and reason for change.

## What changed
List files/skills/contracts and any intentionally deferred work.

## Validation evidence
- [ ] Existing implementation inventory/reuse checked
- [ ] Static contract tests executed and results linked
- [ ] Behavioral tests executed where applicable, otherwise NOT EXECUTED
- [ ] Source/decision traceability checked
- [ ] Authorization & secrets review complete

## Status / risks
Describe PASS/PARTIAL/BLOCKED with precise scope, remaining gaps, and any provider verification pending.

## Governance
No unauthorized task decomposition, no unapproved provider writes, no automatic remediation, no merge without owner review.
